query: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.coverUrl, COUNT(p.id) as photoCount FROM albums a LEFT JOIN photos p ON p.albumId = a.id WHERE (a.coverUrl IS NULL OR a.coverUrl = '') GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.createdAt DESC LIMIT 10;
